info.name: Instana REST API documentation Events API

params.name: to
params.description: A Unix timestamp representing the end of the requested timeframe. Defaults to the current system time

params.name: windowSize
params.description: The size of the requested timeframe, in milliseconds, relative to the 'to' parameter. Defaults to 10 minutes (600000 milliseconds) if neither 'windowSize' nor 'from' are provided. Resulting timeframe range = [to - windowSize, to]

params.name: from
params.description: A Unix timestamp representing the start of the requested timeframe. Can be used as an alternative to 'windowSize' to define the timeframe. If both 'from' and 'windowSize' are provided, 'from' takes precedence. Resulting timeframe range = [from, to]

params.name: filterEventUpdates
params.description: Flag to filter the results to only show events with state changes within the timeframe.

params.name: excludeTriggeredBefore
params.description: Flag to filter the results to exclude events that have been triggered before the timeframe. This also filters out events with state changes within the timeframe if the events' start times begin before the timeframe.

params.name: includeAgentMonitoringIssues
params.description: Flag to filter the results to include Agent Monitoring Issues.

params.name: includeKubernetesInfoEvents
params.description: Flag to filter the results to include Kubernetes Info Events.

params.name: eventTypeFilters
params.description: A string representing an event type - an INCIDENT, ISSUE, or CHANGE. This query can be repeated to use multiple filters.
